Notices for packages bundled inside dndkit.min.js

dndkit.min.js is an esbuild bundle (recipe in ../README.md) of four packages, each
compiled in whole or in part:

  @dnd-kit/core           6.3.1   MIT
  @dnd-kit/sortable      10.0.0   MIT
  @dnd-kit/utilities      3.2.2   MIT
  @dnd-kit/accessibility  3.1.1   MIT

All four ship the same licence file (Copyright (c) 2021, Claudéric Demers); it is the
LICENSE file in this folder. Their npm tarballs carry no other notices. tslib, listed as
a dependency of each, is not in the bundle (the ES builds import nothing from it);
react and react-dom are left external.
